desc.zh: 公众号文章、视频号、聊天与群聊、收藏，按需开启。
desc.en: Official Account articles, Channels, chats and Favorites — turn on what you need.

desc.zh: 记录打开过的公众号文章：标题、公众号、作者、发布时间、正文；正文配图可下载。
desc.en: Records the Official Account articles you open: title, account, author, time and full text; images can be downloaded.

desc.zh: 采集视频号的视频、作者、互动数据与评论，以及带货助手的选品商品。
desc.en: Collects Channels videos, authors, engagement and comments, plus products from the shopping assistant.

desc.zh: 列出会话，选中的会话才读取消息。
desc.en: Lists your chats; messages are read only for the chats you pick.

risk.zh: 通过读取本机的微信数据库获取（只读，不改动微信）。
risk.en: Read from the WeChat database on this computer (read-only; WeChat itself is untouched).

desc.zh: 点「读入收藏」时读取微信收藏。
desc.en: Reads your WeChat Favorites when you click Read Favorites.

risk.zh: 通过读取本机的微信数据库获取（只读，不改动微信）。
risk.en: Read from the WeChat database on this computer (read-only; WeChat itself is untouched).

desc.zh: 在微信里多选消息 → 转发 → 其他应用 → 囤囤鼠，聊天记录直接进来。只读你转发的内容。
desc.en: In WeChat, select messages → Forward → Other apps → Nuttle, and the chat comes straight in. Only reads what you forward.

desc.zh: 在浏览器里打开的飞书云文档存下全文；用你自己在飞书开放平台建的应用，同步关注的群聊消息。
desc.en: Keeps the full text of Feishu docs you open in the browser, and syncs the group chats you watch using an app you create on the Feishu Open Platform.

desc.zh: 在浏览器里打开的飞书文档：标题、链接、全文（标题、列表、表格按原文顺序）和图片。
desc.en: Feishu docs you open in the browser: title, link, full text (headings, lists and tables in order) and images.

desc.zh: 选好要关注的群，每 10 分钟同步一次新消息。需要先填你的应用凭据。
desc.en: Pick the groups to watch; new messages sync every 10 minutes. Needs your app credentials first.

desc.zh: 采集点开的笔记：标题、正文、作者、互动数据与评论，以及图片与视频。
desc.en: Collects the notes you open: title, text, author, engagement and comments, plus images and videos.

desc.zh: 点开的笔记、评论、图片与视频。
desc.en: Notes you open, comments, images and videos.

desc.zh: 采集你看过的作品与评论。
desc.en: Collects the posts you watch and their comments.

desc.zh: 看过的作品、推荐 / 搜索 / 作者主页里刷到的作品、评论与回复，以及可下载的视频。
desc.en: Posts you watch or see in feeds, search and profiles, comments and replies, plus downloadable videos.

desc.zh: 采集你看过的视频与评论。
desc.en: Collects the videos you watch and their comments.

desc.zh: 看过的作品、精选 / 搜索 / 作者主页里刷到的作品、评论与回复，以及可下载的视频。
desc.en: Videos you watch or see in feeds, search and profiles, comments and replies, plus downloadable videos.

desc.zh: 采集你看过的视频与评论。
desc.en: Collects the videos you watch and their comments.

desc.zh: 看过的视频、首页推荐和热门里刷到的视频、评论与楼中楼，以及可下载的视频。
desc.en: Videos you watch or see in your feed and Popular, comments and replies, plus downloadable videos.

desc.zh: 采集浏览过的帖子与视频：正文、作者、互动数据；打开帖子详情时一并采集回复。
desc.en: Collects the posts and videos you view: text, author and engagement, plus replies when you open a post.

desc.zh: 浏览过的帖子、视频与回复。
desc.en: Posts, videos and replies you view.

desc.zh: 采集浏览过的帖子：标题、正文、版块、分数、评论数；打开帖子时一并采集评论与楼中楼。
desc.en: Collects the posts you view: title, text, subreddit, score and comment count, plus threaded comments when you open a post.

desc.zh: 浏览过的帖子与评论。
desc.en: Posts and comments you view.

desc.zh: 采集你看过的视频与评论。
desc.en: Collects the videos you watch and their comments.

desc.zh: 看过的视频、搜索和列表里刷到的视频、评论与回复，以及可下载的视频。
desc.en: Videos you watch or see in search and lists, comments and replies, plus downloadable videos.

desc.zh: 采集你看过的帖子、Reels 与评论。
desc.en: Collects the posts and Reels you view and their comments.

desc.zh: 看过的帖子与 Reels、评论与回复，以及可下载的视频。
desc.en: Posts and Reels you view, comments and replies, plus downloadable videos.

desc.zh: 采集商品页的变体信息：ASIN、颜色、尺寸与可售状态。
desc.en: Collects product variations: ASIN, color, size and availability.

desc.zh: 商品页的变体信息。
desc.en: Variations on product pages.

desc.zh: 记录卖家精灵网页版的数据，供分析使用。
desc.en: Records data from SellerSprite for analysis.

desc.zh: 卖家精灵网页版的数据。
desc.en: Data from SellerSprite pages.

desc.zh: 记录 Keepa 页面的数据，供分析使用。
desc.en: Records data from Keepa for analysis.

desc.zh: Keepa 页面的数据。
desc.en: Data from Keepa pages.

desc.zh: 记录飞鱼数据页面的数据，供分析使用。
desc.en: Records data from Feiyu Data for analysis.

desc.zh: 飞鱼数据页面的数据。
desc.en: Data from Feiyu Data pages.
